articles.title: XRP Ledger adds new controls for banks, stablecoins and tokenized funds
articles.snippet: The feature lets businesses give separate accounts limited powers such as approving customers or making payments, while keeping the keys that control their main holdings offline.

articles.title: EU securities regulator gives crypto platforms 3 months to remove unauthorized stablecoins
articles.snippet: ESMA said authorized platforms must block new access to stablecoins that fail to meet MiCA rules, while national authorities oversee existing customer holdings.

articles.title: French lawmakers back stablecoin swap tax in 2027 budget bill
articles.snippet: France’s Finance Committee backed taxes on stablecoin swaps, as well as unrealized crypto gains when households with more than 800,000 euros move abroad.

articles.title: China’s P2P stablecoin wallets surge 43x, Korea’s $450B crypto economy: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Despite ongoing bans, China has seen a big surge in peer-to-peer stablecoin use. New figures show South Korea’s $450B crypto economy is the largest in East Asia.

articles.title: Samsung Wallet Taps Solana for USDC Transfers on 82M US Galaxy Devices
articles.snippet: Users can send USDC across borders from late October, three months after Samsung teased stablecoin support without naming a blockchain.
